notes.title: v0.9.1 - Global chat history, new artifacts and many balance changes
notes.notes:
∙ Made some improvements in the loading screen.
∙ Executioner stats have been changed and now has a cleave attack.
∙ Butcher has also cleave attack and lifesteal.
∙ Added 7 new artifacts.
∙ When the orc drummer plays the drums he now gives a random permanent buff to his allies.
∙ Fixed a crash in the merchant shop when having a talisman piece in your backpack.

∙ When a hero tests his courage succesfully when the orc waves his banner the camera focuses on that hero.

∙ Fixed a bug with break magic not working properly at higher levels and reworked level 2 and 3.

∙ Evil Sorcerer now has a teleport form of evasion/counter attack that triggers every 1-2 attacks

∙ Added a pit trap in the editor (examples of how it works will be posted soon).
∙ When replaying a quest you will get stronger and stronger monsters until it eventually becomes impossible... 
∙ Its no longer possible to have on same hero 2 pieces of equipment of same type (e.g. 2 pairs of boots, 2 bows and 2 heavy armor)
∙ Blacksmith always shows tooltip when draged over an item and also reports who has the item equiped(if any).
∙ Dark Monk now starts with +1 life.
∙ Introduction quest now only has 1 magic pot.
∙ Added chat history for all messages in the system, you should now be able to see what others have been previously talking.
∙ Fixed a bug with the Torch item not working.
∙ Fixed an issue with picking up an artifact that could lock the game or desync a multiplayer game.
